requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write the provided prescaler divider value to the IWDG_PR.PR field.
requirements.verification: The host unit test passes when a function takes a preset prescaler value such as 0x00000004 and writes it to register ll_iwdg_regs[IWDG_PR_OFFSET/4U] directly, representing a divider / 64.
